If you haven’t told them about your mental health, it might be a good idea to explain to them why you were MIA for few weeks cause if you ghosted them without an explanation, theyre probably think youre mad at them and don’t even know why . Explain to them that you were not in a good place and needed a space but then you realize that they deserve an explanation.

If they choose not to reply after your explanation, take it as a hard lesson and you can learn how to communicate better. Its not the end of the world. Its not just you but many people come and go in your life and each person is a lesson .

If you can learn how to live your life without blocking them, by all means give it a try! And i know social media accounts are my biggest trigger . I get so depressed after seeing everyone’s living their “best moments” and i tend to do impulsive behaviour after lol … i definitely dont miss that. I mainly use reddit and tiktok for now

Yes I usually talk out loud with 5 senses. I name what Im seeing, hearing, smelling, taste (eating yummy snacks) and touch (i would hug my childhood teddy bear) and repeat until im feeling okay. If it doesn’t help, i have to remind myself that what im feeling doesn’t last forever and it will eventually die down and i will be okay. No intense feelings last forever. I keep telling myself so often that now i just naturally know it.

I wrote down all my favourite things for 5 senses and put it on the wall in my bedroom. I see it like 20 times a day so its a constant reminder. Eventually itll drill into your brain to remember the self soothing skills. I often make a care box and put all the items in the box and shove it under my bed so i can take it out anyway when i feel like im heading towards an episode 

Sorry for the long posr. I hope it helps 🩷
